newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka blue chips up as demand outpaces supply.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka blue chips up as demand outpaces supply.

text.p: Sri Lanka's three highly capitalised blue chip conglomerates, John Keells Holdings, Hayleys and Aitken Spence, rose sharply in early Wednesday trading, brokers said.
John Keells was 2.21 percent or six rupees up at 278, Hayleys was 1.8 percent or 4.50 rupees up at 255 and Aitken Spence rose 4.94 percent or eight rupees to 170.
"The shares are rising due to more demand than supply," said a local broker.
Blue chip stocks were in demand after analysts upgraded earnings forecasts for conglomerates for the current financial year ended March 31, 1998, brokers said.
